description: What the binder accepts and refuses in LOOKUP (ADR-0016, ADR-0020): the source is a table by name, the column one of its columns, the condition a condition over the source's columns, with the document's variables as THIS.name; a query function does not nest inside another's arguments.
accept: LOOKUP(Rates, rate, code = THIS.code AND rate > DECIMAL(THIS.qty, 0))

reject.reason: the condition must be a condition; code is text
inside the condition a bare name is a column; the document's qty is THIS.qty
THIS names a variable the document lacks
THIS is only valid inside LOOKUP and QUERY

reject.formula: LOOKUP(Rates, rate, code = LOOKUP(Rates, code, TRUE))
reject.reason: a query function does not nest inside another's arguments
only scalar variables are reachable through THIS yet
a field path inside a condition
the source is a name, not text
the column is a name, not text
a text column compared with a number
